root_ori.unit: sqrt(0.5) times rotation matrix entries; nominal in rad

definition.state_loss: mean squared error over h successor steps and all channels weighted by 1/nominal_error^2; then mean over sampled windows
definition.group_columns: unweighted group MSE over channels and all h successors
definition.window: Within-lane valid 20 ms recorded clipped commands. Complete terminal interval included; no crossing reset or cohort boundary.
definition.sampling: Each side/h/stratum independently capped without replacement, numpy seed 301. All, physical start mode, and reference start phase overlap; do not add their counts.
definition.physical_columns: Endpoint errors at successor h. RMSE/P95/max over finite windows; nonfinite windows counted.
definition.interpretation: Recorded-action open loop on the transferred robot and door; dataset, channels and scales differ from G1.
